ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75-80% of surface area consists of high-intensity white pixels, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated primarily at the peripheral trailing edges and central peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white geometric blobs cover the interior of each lobe. A thick, continuous low-intensity black band (approx. 5-10 pixels wide in this resolution) maps the trailing edge. A dark, roughly triangular focal cluster is located at the center-bottom coordinates where the fluke meets the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 85 degrees; bounding-box depth is pronounced, extending into the mid-section of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile; the left lobe trailing edge exhibits a higher frequency of low-amplitude peaks (saw-tooth pattern), while the right lobe trailing edge presents a more smoothed, undulating topography with fewer distinct pixel peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch; leading edge (partially visible) suggests a convex curve.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive dark vertical column of pigmentation originates at the peduncle and flares outward into the lower-central region of the fluke surface.
